key_features_and_micro_interactions.hero_cinematic: Full-screen video / particle canvas background with fireworks/spark effects, explosive headline typography, and pulsating 'Book Your Event' CTA button.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.animated_stat_counters: 19+ Years Experience, 2500+ Grand Events, 500+ Celebrity & Artist Bookings, 100% Dhamaka Guarantee with animated counter scroll trigger.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.service_highlight_cards: Glow/pulse hover states with 1px animated gold/fire borders, category badges, and quick-enquire action.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.filterable_artist_and_event_gallery: Masonry multi-tab lightbox grid filtering by (All, Weddings, Indian Artists, International/Russian Artists, Mascots, Special Effects, Sound & Lights). Includes video preview modals.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.draggable_whatsapp_floating_button: Pulsing green-gold floating badge with direct pre-filled WhatsApp inquiry link ('Hi Vineet Events, I want to book an event...').
key_features_and_micro_interactions.ai_chatbot_widget: Interactive 'Dhamaka Event AI Assistant' widget for instant cost estimation, venue suggestions in Dehradun & PAN India, artist recommendations, and booking query.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.enquiry_popup_form: Royal gold modal form with interactive multi-step service selector, date picker, budget estimator, guest count, and instant submission.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.confetti_burst_success: Explosive canvas confetti explosion on form submit success with instant quote ID and SMS/WhatsApp confirmation toast.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.parallax_particles: Canvas spark/firefly particle overlay floating in dark gold/maroon sections.
key_features_and_micro_interactions.admin_dashboard: Secure admin panel (credentials: admin@vineetevents.com / dhamaka123) with Enquiries Management, Status tracking (Pending, Contacted, Booked, Archived), Filters, Stats Analytics, and Add New Event/Artist.

data_testid_guidelines.general: Every button, link, form field, tab, card, modal toggle, and interactive element MUST have a unique descriptive data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact dark royal gold aesthetic (#0A0508 background, #EAB308 royal gold, #881337 deep maroon, #FF4D00 fire orange accents). Never use plain white or corporate blue backgrounds.

Implement high-energy micro-interactions: glowing/pulsing buttons, confetti explosion on form submission using canvas-confetti, floating spark particle canvas overlay, smooth Framer Motion entrance animations.
Build a complete multi-page experience using React Router DOM with persistent top header navigation and footer.
Include a functional AI Chatbot widget with smart automated responses for booking queries, pricing ranges, and venue advice.
Include a floating draggable WhatsApp button anchored to bottom right with pulse animation.
Build the Admin Login & Dashboard flow with local storage persistence, demo data pre-populated, search, filter, status toggles, and new enquiry creator.
Ensure 100% responsive design from mobile devices to large screens, maintaining APCA/WCAG contrast compliance across gold text against dark backgrounds.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
